{{Top|canon=Merj}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
The name and location of the '''Morseerian homeworld''' was a jealously-guarded secret of the [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] generally held that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> only the Morseerians knew its [[Astrogation/Legends|astronavigational]] coordinates,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and members of the species chose [[Death/Legends|death]] over revealing this information. The species attained [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] technology at some point and spread out beyond their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to found colonies, such as [[Morseer]], with which others most strongly associated them and from which they took their name. This helped them protect the location of their planet of origin because Morseerian colonists and spacers could become the public face of the species.<ref name="UAA" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] claimed Morseer as its territory after it conquered the [[Drackmarian]]s, the dominant species in the area and the nominal masters of the Morseerian colonists.<ref name="TaBSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Empire organized a concerted effort to find the Morseerian homeworld, which drove many Morseerians to clandestinely support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and thus sabotage such prying. This subterfuge worked, as the Empire failed to discover the location of the planet.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
